### New

* **Reading data backups over Wi-Fi.** The [InkSights](https://github.com/dq-stack/InkSights) calibre backup plugin (1.1.0 or newer) can now back up each book's reading data (`.sdr` sidecars) and the InkSights reading log while the Kindle is connected wirelessly, not just over USB.

calibre can read files only in `documents/` and `reading-stats/`. Nothing else on the Kindle can be read, and nothing is written.

### Upgrading from v1.0.0

Unzip `calibre-wireless-1.1.0.zip` onto the Kindle's root, replacing the old files. Your settings in `extensions/calibre-wireless/config.sh` are kept.
